dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hi there, First National.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi. I sent a payment to the wrong person. Two hundred pounds. I realised about ten minutes after I did it.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Theo Marsh.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right, let me have a look... Yes, I see the payment.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can you do anything?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can log it as a potential misdirected payment. There may be a recall option. Let me check.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Please.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Okay, I've submitted something. I'm not a hundred percent sure it was the right form — I'll double-check with my supervisor.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Should I call back?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Leave it a day and see what happens.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: What's my reference number? This is two hundred pounds.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I'd have to check. Let me take your number and call you back if there's an update.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Okay... I'll wait I suppose.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I need to cancel a transfer I made five minutes ago. Wrong account. Three hundred pounds.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Once a transfer has processed there's no way to cancel it.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Five minutes ago — surely the bank can do something?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It's already cleared into the other account. That's how Faster Payments works.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can you raise a recall? I've seen that mentioned on your website.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: We don't do recalls. That's not a service we offer.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can you transfer me to someone who can help?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: There isn't a specific team for that. Your best bet is to contact the person you sent it to and ask for it back.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I don't know who I sent it to — I typed the wrong number. Can I at least speak to a manager?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: They'll tell you the same thing. Sorry.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. My name is Rachel. Can I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Of course. It's David Kim, twenty-first of September 1986.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you David, identity confirmed. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I made a transfer about thirty minutes ago to the wrong account by mistake. I sent five hundred pounds to someone I don't know. I need to get it back urgently.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I completely understand the urgency. I can see the transfer. For Faster Payments, once processed it's at the receiving bank, but I can immediately raise a recall request which formally asks them to return the funds.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Will they have to return it?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Under UK payment rules, if the recipient confirms it was received in error they must return it. The process can take up to two weeks if they don't respond promptly. Reference number CAN-2024-7815 — you'll receive email updates. The sort code you sent to is Barclays, so you can also call Barclays' fraud line in parallel and quote a misdirected payment.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'll do that right now. That's incredibly helpful. Thank you Rachel.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National Bank. I'm Femi. Can I start by confirming your name and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Morning. Petra Kovacs, fourth of April 1989.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Petra, you're verified. What's happened today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I've done something really stupid — I sent money to the wrong account. Four hundred and fifty pounds. It was my sister's old account number that she's since closed.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Don't worry, we can deal with this. How long ago was the transfer?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Maybe forty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Do you know which bank your sister uses?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Nationwide, same as me.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Even better — an intra-bank recall is usually quicker. I'm raising it now. Reference CAN-2024-8010. Because the account was closed, Nationwide should automatically return the funds within forty-eight hours since closed accounts can't hold balances.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Oh, that's actually reassuring. So it should come back on its own?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: The recall ensures it's formally tracked and handled. I've also sent you an email confirmation. Is there anything else?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Thank you so much Femi. That's a massive relief.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good evening, First National Bank.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Good evening. I urgently need to cancel a transfer I made by mistake. It was fifteen hundred pounds to the wrong account.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand, I'll try to help. Your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Vanessa Okonkwo.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Ms. Okonkwo, let me look at this... I can see the transfer. I'm going to need to put you on hold and speak to our payments team.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Please be quick, every minute counts.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you for holding. The payments team has advised they need you to fill in a form online. I'm just getting the web address — actually, my screen isn't loading. I'm going to have to call you back with the details.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Call me back? When?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Within the hour. The transfers team are aware of the situation.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Are they raising a recall? Is anything actually happening right now?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I've flagged it. Someone will call you. Thanks for your patience.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. My name is Carly. Can I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yeah hi, um — it's, uh, Marcus Webb. And um, my date of birth is, uh — fifth — no, fifteenth? Fifteenth of, uh, July. Nineteen eighty-eight.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Webb, I've confirmed your identity. What can I help you with?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: So I, uh — I made a transfur? Like I sent money? And uh — I realized straight away like, literally — uh — within like ten minutes that I'd, like, put the wrong — uh — account number in. Like I transposed some digits or something.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I completely understand. How much was the transfer for?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh, six — six hundred and, uh — fifty pounds. Yeah, six-fifty.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can see that payment. Since it went via Faster Payments it's already settled, but I'm raising a formal recall request now. This contacts the receiving bank and formally requests the funds back.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Right, yeah. And like — uh — [inaudible] — what are the chances they, like, give it back?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: If the account number doesn't match any active account, the funds are returned automatically within forty-eight hours. If there is an account holder, they're legally obligated to return funds received in error. Reference number CAN-2024-8099. You'll receive an email confirmation.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Okay brilliant. Um, yeah — like, uh — thank you. That's — that's taken a load off.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National Bank. This is Alex.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Alex, I've made a terrible mistake. I sent eight hundred pounds to the wrong account number. I mixed up two digits. Can you cancel it?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Let me see if there's a cancellation window. What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Diana Patel.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Ms. Patel, I can see the transfer. Unfortunately I'm unable to reverse it at this stage — Faster Payments are instantaneous once processed.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Is there absolutely nothing you can do?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I... actually wait. I should have offered this immediately — I can raise a formal recall request. I apologise for not leading with that. That's the correct process. Let me verify your identity first — full name and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Diana Patel, thirtieth of March 1994.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. Raising the recall now. Reference CAN-2024-7901. The sort code you sent to is Santander — you can also call Santander's fraud line directly and quote a misdirected payment to help expedite recovery alongside our recall.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'll call them now. Thank you for catching yourself on that.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I apologise again for the initial confusion. Is there anything else?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, I'm going to call Santander right now.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, good afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I've been trying to cancel a payment I made this morning. One hundred and twenty pounds. I think I got the account number wrong.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Let me see. Name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yemi Adewale.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Looking at your account now... Okay, I see the transfer. I should mention — there's nothing we can do to cancel a Faster Payment once it's sent.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Really? Not even a recall request? I've seen it mentioned on your website.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Oh — you're right, I apologise. That is absolutely a service we offer and I should have mentioned it straight away. Before I raise it, let me properly verify your identity — full name and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yemi Adewale, ninth of October 1997.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. And the account number you intended to send versus what you actually sent?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Meant to send to 23456781 but I think I put 23456718 — transposed the last two digits.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Got it. Raising the recall now. Reference CAN-2024-8043. The receiving bank has five working days to respond. If the account doesn't exist or is closed, funds return automatically within forty-eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Thank you — I did have to prompt you but I appreciate you following through.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Completely fair. I apologise for the initial confusion.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hi, thanks for calling. What can I do for you?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'm waiting on a new debit card. Ordered it eight days ago and nothing's arrived.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Can I get your name and postcode?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Marcus Webb, SW6 3TP.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Okay, I can see something here. Shows dispatched last Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That was five days ago. So where is it?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It's probably still in the post. These can get delayed sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Is there a tracking number? Can I check where it is?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: We don't offer tracking on standard card deliveries unfortunately.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: And if it doesn't arrive by end of the week?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Give us a call back and we can look at options at that point.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Alright. I suppose I'll wait then.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I ordered a new card nearly two weeks ago and it hasn't arrived. Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Cards usually take two to three weeks, so you're still within the normal window. Just wait a bit longer.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Two to three weeks? The website said five to seven working days. It's already been ten working days.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yeah, sometimes it takes longer depending on Royal Mail. There's nothing I can do until it's been a full three weeks.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can you at least check it went to the right address?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I don't have that in front of me right now. You'd need to go into a branch for that.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: This is unacceptable. Can I speak to a manager?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: They'll tell you the same thing. Call back after three weeks if it still hasn't come.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: You're through to First National.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yeah hi, I've been waiting on a card for like nearly two weeks now and I'm getting pretty fed up.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: What's your account number?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I don't have it in front of me. Can't you look me up by name?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I need the account number to access anything.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right. The card system shows it sent. I can't tell you more than that.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: When was it sent? And where was it sent to?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It just says dispatched. These things get delayed all the time, not our problem.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Not your problem? I can't use my account without a card.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: You can use the app. The card will come when it comes.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can you reissue it at least?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Not until it's officially lost, which is after 30 days. Those are the rules. Sorry I can't help more.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling First National Bank. My name is Sarah. Can I take your full name and date of birth to verify your identity?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, it's James Thornton, fourteenth of March 1988.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Thornton, I've verified your account. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I ordered a replacement card about ten days ago and it still hasn't arrived. I'm getting a bit worried.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I completely understand, that must be frustrating. Let me pull up the card order now. I can see it was dispatched six days ago by standard post — delivery is typically five to seven working days, so you should receive it by Thursday at the latest.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Okay, that's reassuring. Can you confirm it went to the right address?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Of course. I can read back the first line of the address on file — it shows 14 Maple Avenue. Is that correct?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: If it hasn't arrived by end of day Thursday, please call us back and we can cancel and reissue with tracked delivery at no charge. I've made a note on your account.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Great, I'll wait until Thursday then. Thanks for your help.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's everything.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National Bank. This is Daniel. Before we begin, could I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Of course. It's Priya Mehta, twenty-second of November 1990.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Priya, identity confirmed. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: So I got a new card issued about a week ago — I had to replace my old one — and it just hasn't come through yet. Is that normal?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That's a really common concern. Delivery is five to seven working days from dispatch. Let me check where yours is in the process.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I just want to make sure it's not lost or sent to the wrong place.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Completely understandable. I can see it was dispatched four days ago, so you're well within the window. The card was sent to the address ending in Birch Road — is that right?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, that's my address.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: You're in good shape. I'd expect it to arrive tomorrow or the day after. If you reach next Tuesday and it still hasn't arrived, call us and we'll issue a new one same day with tracked post.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's really helpful, thanks Daniel.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: My pleasure. I've added a note to your account for reference. Anything else today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's all.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, how can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I need to ask about a card I ordered. It should have arrived by now and I'm starting to worry.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Can I get your name please?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Diana Russo.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: One moment... okay, I can see an order. It was sent — sorry, my system is very slow today.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's okay. Can you tell me when it was dispatched?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It does show dispatched, yes. I'm going to have to put you on a brief hold.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Sure, that's fine.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you for holding. I'm going to have to transfer you to our card services team, they'll be able to give you more detail.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Wait — before you transfer me, can you at least confirm the address on file is correct?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: The card services team will go through all of that with you. Transferring you now, have a good day.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling First National Bank. My name is Claire. Can I take your full name and date of birth to verify your identity?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh yeah, it's — sorry, um — Thomas, Thomas Kieran, no wait, Kearney. Thomas Kearney. And uh, date of birth is the, uh, third of — no, fourth of August, nineteen eighty-seven.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Kearney, I've verified your account. What can I help you with today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yeah so, I um — my cart hasn't arrived? Like my new bank cart, I ordered it, I don't know, like over a week ago now, maybe ten days?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand. Let me check the status of the card dispatch for you.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: It's just — I've been using cash for everything which is like, you know, really annoying. And I'm worried it got like [inaudible] or sent to the wrong place or something.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can see the card was dispatched seven days ago. It's right at the edge of the standard delivery window, so I'd expect it to arrive very soon — most likely today or tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Oh okay. And it's going to my — uh, my address on file? Like the one in — um, sorry, in Coventry?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes, I can confirm it was sent to the Coventry address we have on record. If it doesn't arrive by the end of this week, call us back and I can cancel and reissue immediately.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Right yeah, that's — uh, that's good. And there's no — like [inaudible] — no extra charge for a replacement?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: No charge at all. I've noted today's call on your account. Is there anything else I can help with?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's — yeah, I think that's everything. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm calling about a replacement card. Ordered it about a week and a half ago and nothing's arrived.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Let me pull up your account — what surname is it?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Patterson.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right, I can see a card order here — actually, hold on. I need to properly verify your identity before I share any account details. I apologise, I should have started with that. Can I take your full name and date of birth please?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No worries at all. Emily Patterson, second of June 1995.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Emily, I've verified you now. The card was dispatched eight days ago, so it's just coming to the end of the standard delivery window. If it doesn't arrive by this Friday I can cancel and reissue with tracked delivery at no charge.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's fine, I can wait until Friday. Just wanted to make sure nothing had gone wrong.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Completely understandable. I've added a note on your account so you won't need to re-explain if you do call back. Is there anything else I can help with?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's great. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hi, First National, how can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: My daughter is waiting for a transfer I made yesterday morning. Two hundred and fifty pounds. She hasn't received it.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Margaret Hobbs.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Let me look... I can see the payment. It shows it was sent.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: She definitely hasn't received it though. Her account is empty.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It might still be processing. Sometimes it takes twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: It's been over twenty-four hours already.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right. Well I can submit a trace request. It might take a few days to come back.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: A few days? She needs that money for food shopping.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand. I'll put in the request. There's a reference I'll note on your account.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: What's the reference number so I can tell my daughter?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I don't have a number to give you yet. The request needs to be processed first. Just wait for now.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I sent money to my friend four days ago and he hasn't received it. Seven hundred pounds.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: These things happen. Probably a bank holiday delay.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: There was no bank holiday. I sent it on a normal Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Well sometimes Faster Payments just takes longer. It's out of our system now, not much I can do.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Can't you trace it?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Not until it's been missing for two weeks. Before that it's too early to intervene.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Two weeks? That's seven hundred pounds — my friend needs that money.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Tell him to check with his bank. They might be able to see it their end.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: He has — they say they haven't received anything.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Maybe you entered the wrong details. Not much else I can do.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Transfers, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, hi — I need help with a payment that was sent to me but I haven't received it. It was sent three days ago.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Who are you?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Sorry — Sarah Poulton.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Is this your account the money should have come into?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Then it's a problem with the sending bank. If the payment didn't arrive, NatWest — or whoever sent it — needs to trace it.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I thought you might be able to trace it on your end too?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: We can only see what comes in. We can't trace something that doesn't exist in our system.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: NatWest says it left their system though.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Then it'll arrive eventually. Wait a few more days. These things sort out.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Wait a few more days with money that's apparently disappeared?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Sorry, not much else I can do.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, good morning. This is Dani. Can I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi. It's Alice Greenberg, fourteenth of June 1991.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Alice, you're all verified. How can I help today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I transferred five hundred pounds to my sister three days ago and she still hasn't received it. She's with Lloyds. I'm worried something went wrong.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand how worrying that must be. Let me look at the transfer. I can see the payment left your account on Tuesday via Faster Payments. Do you have the sort code and account number you sent it to?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Those match what we have. The transfer shows as successfully sent on our end, which means the issue is with the receiving bank's processing. I'd recommend your sister also contact Lloyds and quote the payment reference PAY-2024-7765. I'm also raising a payment trace request now.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Should I do both at the same time?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes, it's best to run both simultaneously. Trace reference is TRC-2024-4411 and you'll receive an email update within twenty-four to forty-eight hours. Is there anything else?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's all. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good evening, First National Bank. My name is Ellie. Can I take your full name and date of birth to verify you?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Evening. Amir Hassan, twenty-sixth of August 1987.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Hassan, verified. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I made a bank transfer to pay an invoice — one thousand two hundred — on Wednesday morning. It's now Friday evening and the company says they haven't received it.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can see that transfer left on Wednesday at 10:43. The sort code and account on the payment — do you have those to hand?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Those match exactly what we have. For a business payment of this size at the end of the week, I'm raising a formal payment trace now so we're not relying on the weekend to sort it.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I really appreciate that.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Trace reference TRC-2024-4619. Our payments team will contact the receiving bank first thing Monday. You should have an update by midday Monday. Shall I also note the invoice reference on your account?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Please do. Invoice ref INV-8834.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Noted. Is there anything else I can help with?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's everything. Thank you Ellie.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Morning. I sent an international transfer on Friday and it hasn't been received. It's now Monday. My business partner is waiting on it.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: International transfers — okay. Can I get your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Stuart McCrae.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Let me look at this... For international transfers, there's a separate team that handles those. One moment.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Before you transfer me — can you at least confirm the payment left my account?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It shows a debit, yes. I really need to get the international team for this.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: How long might this take to resolve?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: They'll be best placed to tell you that. Might be a wait. Good luck. Transferring now.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. My name is Ben. Can I take your full name and date of birth for verification?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh yeah, hi. So it's — uh — Cynthia, Cynthia Park. And uh, date of birth is, um, the, uh — seventh of — uh, March. Nineteen eighty-five.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Ms. Park, you're all verified. How can I help today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Okay so, um — I made a transfer? Like I sent money to my — uh — to my cousin? And she's been — like she's been saying she hasn't got it. And it was — uh — like five days ago? I sent like four hundred pounds?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I can see that transfer leaving your account five days ago. It's shown as sent from our end. Do you have the sort code and account number you sent it to?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh yeah, um — hold on — uh, [inaudible] — right, it's, um, 40-22-19 and the account is, uh — 65447821.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Those match the payment we sent. Since it's been five days and the funds haven't been received, I'll raise a payment trace immediately. This contacts the receiving bank directly to locate the funds.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yeah okay, that sounds — uh — yeah, that sounds good. Um, like will she, uh — will she have to do anything on her end?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: She can also contact her bank to flag the incoming payment as missing — that can speed things up. Your trace reference is TRC-2024-4701. You'll receive an email update within twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Brilliant. Yeah, um — thank you. That's — yeah, that's all I needed.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Afternoon. I sent a transfer of three hundred pounds to my landlord on Monday and it hasn't arrived. He's chasing me for it.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand. What name is the account in?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Mine — it's Gareth Collins.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Looking at your recent transfers... I can see the three-hundred-pound payment on Monday. It's showing as sent. Your landlord just needs to wait — there's nothing unusual showing.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's what your colleague told me yesterday and it still hasn't arrived.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Oh — I apologise. If it was sent Monday and still hasn't arrived it's now outside the normal window. I should be raising a payment trace right now, not telling you to wait. Can I verify your identity first — full name and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Gareth Collins, second of January 1980.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Gareth. I'm raising the trace now. Reference TRC-2024-4502. Your landlord's bank will be contacted directly. Resolution is typically twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Thank you. I wish I'd been told this yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That's a fair point and I apologise. The trace is active now.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hi, First National, how can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi — so I withdrew money from the ATM and got less than I asked for. I wanted a hundred and fifty but got a hundred.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Olga Hernandez.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: And when did this happen?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: About two hours ago. St. James Street ATM.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right, I see. These things do happen occasionally with ATMs. I can make a note.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Just a note? Will there be an investigation?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It may trigger a review at some point. If the machine comes up short in its daily balance, the difference gets allocated back.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: And if it doesn't? I'm just waiting and hoping?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Essentially, yes. I've made the note. Call back if you don't hear anything.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Alright.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, I withdrew fifty pounds from your ATM on Oak Street this morning and only got twenty. The machine took my card and gave me twenty quid.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: ATM machines are very reliable. Are you sure you didn't just withdraw twenty?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I am absolutely sure. I pressed fifty on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: It's possible you pressed the wrong button by mistake.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I did not press the wrong button. I want to report this.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: These things are hard to prove without a receipt. Without one there's not much I can do.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: The machine didn't give me a receipt. That's part of the problem. What about CCTV?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: CCTV audits are done quarterly, not on individual reports.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: This is outrageous. I want to raise a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: You can email our complaints team.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. My name is Michelle. Can I take your name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hello, it's Frank Osei, second of July 1975.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Osei, you're verified. How can I help today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I withdrew two hundred pounds from an ATM this afternoon and only received one hundred and sixty. The machine didn't give me an error or a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That's very concerning and I'm sorry that happened. Can I ask which ATM you used — do you have the location?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: It was on the high street — Barton Road, I think it's near the Halifax building.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'm logging an ATM cash discrepancy report right now. The ATM will be physically audited and if the machine is found to be over by forty pounds, it will be refunded to your account automatically within three to five working days. Your case reference is ATM-2024-3312.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: And if it turns out the machine balanced correctly?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: In that case we would review CCTV footage and you'd be able to provide a statement. These cases are resolved in the customer's favour in the vast majority of cases. Is there anything else?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: No, that's very thorough. Thank you Michelle.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National Bank. I'm Kenji. Can I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, yeah — it's Louise Drummond, sixteenth of February 1988.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Louise, you're verified. What can I help with today?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: So this is going to sound weird, but the cash machine shortchanged me. I asked for two-fifty and it only gave me two hundred. And it didn't give me a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: That doesn't sound weird at all — I'm sorry that happened. Do you have the location of the ATM and roughly what time?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Yes, it's outside the Boots on Crown Street. It was at 9:17 this morning — I've got it on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Perfect — that timestamp will really help us pinpoint the machine's transaction log. I'm raising a cash discrepancy report right now. Reference ATM-2024-3551. The machine will be audited within two working days and if the discrepancy is confirmed, fifty pounds will be refunded to your account automatically.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: And what if the audit doesn't show anything?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Our ATM investigations team will review transaction records and CCTV as a next step. Either way your case is formally logged and we will follow up. You'll receive a confirmation by email.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's really good to know. Thank you Kenji.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, First National Bank.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have an issue with an ATM. I withdrew sixty pounds last night and only received forty. The machine didn't give any error.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I take your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Jenna Park.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll need to transfer you to our ATM disputes team — they have direct access to the machine records.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Oh, okay. Before you transfer me — can you give me a reference number?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: They'll generate one for you on the other end. Which ATM was it?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: The one on Duke Street.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Got it. Actually, the transfer might be quicker. Let me put you through now.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Are you going to—

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Transferring you now. They'll have all the details.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, hello.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hello. I used your ATM on Maple Lane this morning and I'm pretty sure it gave me the wrong amount. I asked for eighty and I think I only got sixty.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Right, I can log something for that. Your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Colin Marsh.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Okay Mr. Marsh, let me see what we've got... I'm going to need to bring in a colleague on this actually.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: A colleague? Should I have a pen handy for a reference number?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes — actually, hold on, let me just check something first.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Sure.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: So Mr. Marsh I've had a quick look and I think what we'll do is have our specialist team call you back within two working days.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Call me back? Will I need to explain everything again?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: They'll have some notes from me. Is the number we have on file okay?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I suppose so, but can I just get a reference number for now?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: A reference will be generated when they call. Thanks for your patience Mr. Marsh.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Good afternoon, First National Bank. My name is Sandra. Can I take your full name and date of birth for security?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh yeah, hi. It's, um — Darren, Darren Oakes. And date of birth is, uh — twenty-first, no — yeah, twenty-first of, um, October. Nineteen, uh, eighty-one.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Oakes, I've confirmed your identity. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: So, um, I was at your, uh — like the cash machine? On, uh, Field Road? And I took out — like I put in, uh, I asked for a hundred and, uh, I only got, like — [inaudible] — I think it was like sixty? Or maybe eighty? But definitely not a hundred.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I understand. Do you know roughly what time you used the ATM?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Uh, yeah, it was like around — um — maybe twelve, twelve-thirty? Lunchtime, you know.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm raising a cash discrepancy report for the Field Road ATM, midday today. Your reference number is ATM-2024-3619. The machine will be audited within two working days. If the overage matches your claim, the amount will be refunded automatically.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Oh right yeah. And like — uh — I don't need to do anything else? Like [inaudible] — I don't need to go to the branch or anything?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: No, everything is logged from this call. We'll contact you if we need any additional information.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Okay, brilliant. That's, uh — yeah, that's all I needed. Um, cheers.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: First National Bank, this is Leila.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi Leila, I have a problem with an ATM withdrawal. I asked for a hundred pounds and only got eighty.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: I see. Can I get your name?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Robert Finch.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Mr. Finch, you'd need to visit the branch where the ATM is located to report that directly — they can check the machine on site.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Oh — I wouldn't have thought I'd need to go to the branch. Is that really the process?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Actually — I need to correct myself. I'm sorry, that's not right. You can absolutely report this over the phone and we can raise the investigation from here. I should have offered that straight away. Let me take your details properly — can I verify your identity first? Full name and date of birth?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Robert Finch, twenty-eighth of August 1963.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Thank you Mr. Finch. And which ATM was it?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Erskine Street, outside Tesco.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Got it. I'm raising an ATM cash discrepancy report now. Reference ATM-2024-3499. The audit should be completed within three working days and if confirmed, the twenty pounds will be refunded automatically.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That's much better, thank you.
